akb_registration.kernel_scope: CUDA source census plus two vector-add and one scalar-scale kernel

document.claim_boundary: Eight independent, diverse open-source CUDA codebases are present at exact recorded commits and their complete checked-out GPU source (.cu/.cuh/.mm/.metal) was censused by C2M. Two real NVIDIA cuda-samples vector-add kernels and one literal scalar-scale kernel translated and matched a numpy oracle on Apple Metal; its supported host allocation/copy/launch/free sequence also ran in faithful and unified-memory modes. This is source translation evidence, not a CUDA execution or differential claim: CUDA hardware remains explicitly blocked, and C2M-T3 project-level runtime coverage is still open. The earlier llama.cpp half-point checkout is retained as historical context only and is not part of this primary influence set.

kernel.origin: eight independent, diverse open CUDA codebases at recorded commits

model.reason: this is CUDA source translation, not model inference
